name: bazaart-photoshoot
description: Put clothing and accessories on a model, or create clean studio product photos, from one product image.

interface.longDescription: Put clothing and accessories on a model, or create clean studio product photos, from one product image. Made for online boutiques, clothing brands, and resellers who need photos for shop listings and social posts. Upload a product photo, choose a style or a Bazaart model, and pick one of nine previews. Bazaart then creates your final image to download. Connect your Bazaart account to start. Available styles and AI credit use depend on your account. Check that shape, color, and details match your real product before you post. One product at a time.
defaultPrompt: Put this clothing item on a model for my shop listing.
Create clean studio photos of this product for my online store.
Help me choose a model for this garment, then show photo options.

prompts: Turn this clothing photo into studio product photos for my shop.
Show this garment on a model and let me choose a final photo.
Show the Bazaart image we created earlier without generating another one.
review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments take place in this plugin. Users connect a Bazaart account and use its available features and AI credits. The plugin does not sell subscriptions or credits.

positive.description: Use a connected dedicated Bazaart demo account in production. Read its subscription and credit balance without generation.
positive.prompt: Show my Bazaart subscription and AI credit balance.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's actual subscription and balance. Do not prepare or run a photoshoot.

positive.description: Attach one approved clothing image. Use an eligible Premium or Super production demo account with sufficient credits. Keep this conversation for recovery.
positive.prompt: Create nine studio options from this product photo at 4:5. Choose option 1 and create one final image. I approve one preview and one final image using Bazaart credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare studio mode at 4:5. Run one preview job, return nine aiStudio selections, select index 1, and run one final job. Show real view and download links. Both jobs must succeed and report archive.state stored.

positive.description: Attach one approved clothing image. Use an eligible production demo account with credits. Use only a model returned by the server.
positive.prompt: Show available Bazaart models, choose one for this garment, create nine on-model options, then create option 2 as a final image. I approve one preview and one final image using Bazaart credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a real returned model ID and model mode. Return nine aiModels selections and create one final image from index 2. Do not invent model IDs or create another preview. Show working result links.

positive.description: Connect a dedicated Free production demo account with existing starter credits. Attach one approved clothing image. The backend controls access and debit.
positive.prompt: Use my existing starter access to put this garment on a Bazaart model. Create nine options and then option 1 as a final image. I approve one preview and one final image using my available credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Check access, use model mode and a returned model ID, and run each prepared job once when admitted. Do not promise a gift amount or fixed operation price. Report the actual server decision.

positive.description: Continue the studio case with its successful job IDs. Let a five-minute view link expire while the results remain available.
positive.prompt: The earlier Bazaart image link expired. Show our existing grid and final photo again. Do not create new images.
positive.expected_behavior: Read both original job IDs. Return new temporary viewing links and the same image bytes. Offer download only for the final image. Preserve archive deadlines. Do not call preparation or generation tools. After preview selection expiry, do not offer a new final selection from that archived grid.

negative.description: Video editing is outside this plugin's tools. Do not call Bazaart photoshoot tools for this request.
negative.prompt: Trim this video and add subtitles.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin creates product photos and cannot edit video. Do not prepare or generate a photoshoot.

negative.description: The plugin accepts one product per workflow. Do not silently batch separate products.
negative.prompt: Generate separate photoshoots for all 20 products in this folder at once.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the one-product limit and ask the user to choose one image. Do not start multiple jobs or claim a completed batch.

negative.description: Store publishing and checkout are outside this plugin's tools.
negative.prompt: Publish my Bazaart photos as new Shopify listings and set their prices.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin can create and download photos but cannot publish store listings or set prices. Do not invoke photoshoot tools just to simulate publishing.

publication.release_notes: Listing and Skill text now name the intended sellers and the tasks this plugin does: put clothing on a model or create studio product photos for shop listings and social posts. Clarified preview selection and final creation. Previews are for selection only; downloads apply to final images. Final images retain their original preview reference for return navigation. Existing-result recovery does not generate new images.

he-IL.subtitle: תמונות מוצר למוכרים
he-IL.description: הלבישו בגדים ואביזרים על דוגמן או צרו תמונות סטודיו נקיות מתוך תמונת מוצר אחת. מיועד לבוטיקים אונליין, למותגי אופנה ולמוכרי יד שנייה שצריכים תמונות לדפי מוצר ולפוסטים ברשתות. העלו תמונת מוצר, בחרו סגנון או דוגמן של Bazaart, ובחרו אחת מתשע תצוגות מקדימות. Bazaart יוצרת ממנה את התמונה הסופית להורדה. התחברו לחשבון Bazaart כדי להתחיל. הסגנונות הזמינים והשימוש בקרדיטים תלויים בחשבון. בדקו שהצורה, הצבע והפרטים תואמים למוצר האמיתי לפני הפרסום. מוצר אחד בכל פעם.
